title: Hypergraph Neural Networks for Complex Relational Data: Capturing Higher-Order Dependencies in Real-World Systems

contributions.purpose: 为超图结构数据设计专用神经架构
contributions.mechanism: HyperGNN:把消息传递扩展到超边,超边嵌入(MLP+MAXPOOL)+可学习注意力的自适应聚合
contributions.evaluation: 给出超边消息传递/超边嵌入/注意力聚合公式(方法定性)
contributions.source_quote: By extending message passing to hyperedges and incorporating adaptive aggregation mechanisms, HyperGNN achieves superior performance on multi-relational datasets compared to state-of-the-art GNNs.

contributions.purpose: 实证超图建模优于 GNN 基线
contributions.mechanism: DBLP/STRING/Reddit 上与 GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE/HGNN 对比节点分类
contributions.evaluation: Table 1:HyperGNN DBLP 90.1%、STRING AUC 0.912、Reddit 84.7%,Avg Improvement 18.2%(HGNN 12.5%);声称 18-32% 提升、GPU 推理快 15%
contributions.source_quote: showing 18-32% improvement in node classification and link prediction tasks.

notes: 数据红旗:abstract/分析称 '18-32% improvement in node classification and link prediction',但全文只有一张节点分类表(Table 1),link prediction 结果完全缺失(幻影任务);表内 Avg Improvement 仅 18.2%,与正文反复出现的 '18-32%' 区间自相矛盾(上界无出处)。GAT 引用写成 '(?)' 损坏引用;'Hardware-Aware Optimization / 15% faster on GPU' 与超图主题无关、硬凑且无数据支撑。全部为整齐的圆整数(18.2%/12.5%/15%),疑似造数;正文实质内容仅约 3 页。checklist/正文属典型全 AI 生成短文。
